entities.name: Patron of the Orochi
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa active during the Kami War, the great Patron Kami of the Orochi, appearing as a giant vine-scaled serpent with face masks lining its hide.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: The people for whom the Patron of the Orochi is patron kami and whom it eats as offerings.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which the kami was active.

events.summary: The Patron of the Orochi eats Orochi as offerings.
events.quote: It is known to eat Orochi as offerings.

relations.note: Great Patron Kami of the Orochi.
relations.quote: great Patron Kami of the Orochi
